COD.rationale: Content (red set) is identified and bound to organization/origin metadata that separately marks status; all three features present for the same referent/time.

C.rationale: Explicitly lists represented contents with color attributes and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/record metadata separately marks the content's status/organization distinct from the coordinate content identity.

O.rationale: States how contents are presented/accessed (current completed records) and as conditional candidate records (native_conditional_record).
